description:
The top plot illustrates the relationship between a variable $n$ and $m$. The x-axis is labeled "$m$" and represents a linear scale starting from 0, with a specific symbolic point marked as "$m_0$"; it lacks numeric values, units, and regular tick intervals. The y-axis is labeled "$n$" and features a linear scale starting from 0, with symbolic tick marks at "$w$", "$c-a-s$", and "$c-a$". A single solid black line without markers depicts a repeating sawtooth pattern. The line begins at $y=0$ at a point slightly greater than $x=0$, rises linearly to an initial peak, and then drops vertically to a trough. Dashed lines connect the y-axis value "$c-a$" to the first peak and the y-axis value "$w$" to the first trough. This pattern of linear increases followed by vertical drops repeats, with the troughs consistently returning to $y=w$ while the peak heights sequentially decrease. A dotted horizontal segment indicates a break in the sequence. At the x-axis value of $m_0$, a dashed line connects the y-axis value "$c-a-s$" to the peak of the wave, which then drops again to $w$. Following $m_0$, the sawtooth pattern continues.

The bottom plot illustrates the relationship between a variable $Size_{run}$ and $m$. The x-axis is labeled "$m$" and follows a linear scale starting from 0, featuring a marked symbolic point at "$m_0$" without numeric values, units, or regular tick intervals. The y-axis is labeled "$Size_{run}$" (with an "$a$" positioned near the top of the axis arrow) and uses a linear scale starting from 0, containing symbolic tick marks at "$w+a+s$" and "$c$". A solid black line with no markers displays a sawtooth pattern. The line originates at the coordinates (0,0) and rises linearly to an initial peak, which is connected by a dashed line to the y-axis value "$c$". It then drops vertically to a trough. As the pattern repeats along the x-axis, the peaks sequentially decrease in height while the troughs sequentially increase in height. A dotted horizontal segment denotes a continuation of the pattern. At the x-axis mark $m_0$, a dashed line connects the y-axis value "$w+a+s$" to the trough of the vertical drop. Beyond $m_0$, the sawtooth pattern persists.
